'''Kirr Cyrs''' was one of the first beings to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. He was also the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] of the first colony established on the planet. Kirr Cyrs was generally credited with saying that all life born on Socorro eventually [[Death/Legends|dies]] on Socorro. He was an ancestor of [[Jobany Cyrs]].
